description.en: Unlocks a skill for a character with the standard "sysmes-Skill-00001" message — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunUnlockSkillUseMsg.
Character ID whose skill is unlocked.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Unlock a skill for a character with the standard presentation
RunUnlockSkill("para_cp0008", "who0011");
